text:
RaviG: Quick sync — I'm about to open a PR that adds `toolcall_meta` to streaming deltas for chat/completions. It's additive but could break some reassembly clients. Before I push, wanted to confirm compatibility plan and who can review.

Grace: Can you paste the delta shape you plan to emit?

RaviG: Sure — example stream fragments below (pseudo):
```json
{"type":"delta","delta":{"tool_call":{"name":"search","args":{"q":"foo"}},"toolcall_meta":{"id":"t-123","final":false}}}
{"type":"delta","delta":{"content":"hi"}}
{"type":"done"}
```

Chen: Reassembly clients should ignore unknown keys, we call that out in the streaming spec, but several SDKs violate it. We need a lint + unit test to catch this.

Grace: I can add a smoke test in sdk-js that streams a few events with extra fields and asserts reassembly is identical after ignoring unknown keys. I'll target `tests/streaming/reassembly.unit.ts`.

Jordan: cc @devex — do we have explicit guidance in the API docs that streaming deltas are allowed to have extra fields and must be forward-compatible? If not, we should add a short paragraph and an example.

DevBot: api-linter: found 1 issue — `streaming-spec.md` missing an explicit example for unknown delta keys (rule: STREAM-FWD-COMPAT).

RaviG: Proposed plan:
1) Emit `toolcall_meta` only inside `tool_call` deltas (so clients that don't parse tool_call won't see it).
2) Add doc paragraph + example showing reassembly ignoring unknown keys.
3) Add sdk-js smoke test and a server-side unit test that emits extraneous fields.
4) Gate rollout with header flag: `X-Stream-Feature: toolcall_meta` for canary.

Grace: :thumbsup: I can review the SDK PR Monday. I'll add the test harness and a small fixture.

Chen: I'll update the SDK client to be tolerant (ignore unknown keys) and add a changelog note. Also propose we add a `stream_v=2` metadata field as opt-in marker so we can change shape more easily in future.

RaviG: My preference is not to add `stream_v` right now — it complicates reassembly. Header gating feels simpler for rollout. We can revisit if we need bigger structural changes.

Jordan: Agreed to header gating. Ops question: who will coordinate the dedicated/dedicated-canary rollout?

Lee: I can own the rollout timeline and spin up a canary next week. I'll coordinate with infra to enable the header on a subset of dedicated clusters.

RaviG: Thanks — I'll open the PR WIP now and link it here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9999 (WIP). Assigning review to @Grace and @Chen. Please ping when ready.

Grace: Will do. Ping me when you remove WIP.

Chen: I'll start the SDK changes and link the PR to this thread.

RaviG: One last note — let's add a tiny compatibility test in `api-contract-ci` that runs a reassembly smoke stream with unknown keys to catch regressions in future. Anyone object?

Jordan: No objections. Sounds good.

Lee: Fine by me. I'll coordinate the canary once PRs are merged.

DevBot: deploy-bot: PR 9999 created by RaviG (WIP) — labels: api, streaming, wip.

Grace: Thanks all — will follow up in the PR.
